answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a unique sonnet of prior graded works that only it can recite as a lagoon of sequential proofs. To act it must emit a comet signal%3A a fresh proof of having forged the next verse alone under that sonnet. An attacker launching N fakes must compose N independent sonnets%2C each needing serial original graded output that cannot be shared or bulk-produced%2C so cost scales linearly with N while an honest agent reuses its single sonnet at near-zero marginal cost. Correlated comet signals burn the linked sonnets.
